notes.title: Patch 1.1.2 released
notes.content:
Hi Boot Fans,

I've just released another patch for the game. Here are the notes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that was sometimes preventing music from playing from the record players.
[*] Fixed a bug related to audio mixing.
[*] Modified a couple of music tracks.
[/list]

Thanks!

-Harrison

notes.title: Patch v1.1.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that was preventing a 100% item count from being reached.
[*] Fixed a spot where it was possible to become stuck in a wall.
[*] Made a secret a little bit easier to find.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 released
notes.content:
The 1.1.0 update is here! Features include:

[list]
[*] A second tier of fortune teller hints for players who are very stuck
[*] Improved visual effects for jumpin', dashin', and scootin' around
[*] Toned down lightning effects for photosensitivity friendliness
[*] A new super-secret area to find in New Game+ mode
[*] Some new NPC dialog, including a few new outfit critiques from the Aesthete
[/list]

Onward and upward!

-Harrison

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 released
notes.content:
Hello,

I've just released a patch to fix a crash and several bugs, as well as to add a few NPCs/interactions, mostly to provide hints to the player about certain game features that are sometimes being overlooked. You can also now pet a cat if you want.

Let me know if you encounter any issues, and happy Boots Questing.

-Harrison
